name: page
title: Page
description: A header, the main region and a footer in a frame as tall as the viewport.
use: The frame of a document that scrolls as a whole. Put it on the element that holds the header, the main region and the footer, and give the main region grow(1) so the footer stays at the foot of a short page. A column that does not need the viewport's height is written with utilities alone: flex flex-col.

instead.when: A sidebar stays in place while the main region scrolls

platform.fallback: The minimum height is 100vh, which on a phone can be taller than what its toolbars leave visible

classes.name: page
classes.description: The frame: a column at least as tall as the viewport, measured in dvh. It draws nothing
